Name: NCA Essential Cybersecurity Controls (ECC-1:2018)
Description: The Essential Cybersecurity Controls (ECC-1:2018) were developed by the National Cybersecurity Authority (NCA) of Saudi Arabia to set minimum cybersecurity requirements for organizations operating on Oracle Cloud Infrastructure (OCI).

Requirements.Name: 1-4-1 Cybersecurity Roles and Responsibilities
Requirements.Description: Cybersecurity roles and responsibilities must be clearly defined, assigned to authorized personnel, and segregated to avoid conflict of interest.

Requirements.Name: 1-5-1 Cybersecurity Risk Management
Requirements.Description: Enable continuous threat detection and Cloud Guard security zones across OCI compartments.

Requirements.Name: 2-2-1 Identity and Access Management (IAM)
Requirements.Description: Access to OCI resources must require MFA, strong password policies, and API key rotation.

Requirements.Name: 2-5-1 Network Security Management
Requirements.Description: OCI Virtual Cloud Networks (VCNs), Security Lists, and Network Security Groups must restrict internet exposure.

Requirements.Name: 2-7-1 Data and Information Protection
Requirements.Description: Object Storage buckets and Block Volumes must be encrypted with Vault keys and prohibited from public access.

Requirements.Name: 2-8-1 Cryptography and Key Management
Requirements.Description: Cryptographic keys and secrets must be protected within OCI Vault with auto-rotation.

Requirements.Name: 2-12-1 Event Logs and Monitoring Management
Requirements.Description: OCI Audit logs and event rules must be enabled and retained for compliance auditing.
